title: Context file frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter required on every .context/**/*.md file.

title.description: Human-readable title matching the H1 heading.

type.description: File category — matches the subdirectory (plans/ → plan, findings/ → finding, analysis/ → analysis, follow-ups/ → follow-up). known-issue is produced by design-debate when a debate returns do-not-proceed.

status.description: Lifecycle status. For type: plan — draft until reviewed, ready once approved and queued, active once a worktree/branch referencing the plan exists (implementation actually underway), done when complete, superseded when replaced. For type: finding/follow-up — active means still outstanding/unresolved (no ready/active split for these two types), done when actioned, superseded when replaced. deferred applies per value-rubric.md's read protocol (paired with a deferred_until field) and is not currently emitted by any skill's default workflow.

date.description: Creation date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Do not update on subsequent edits.

related.description: Relative paths to related .context files. Omit the field entirely if there are no related files.

effort.description: T-shirt-sized effort estimate. Applies to PLAN; see .claude/instructions/value-rubric.md. Omit for types it doesn't apply to.

value.description: Benefit-of-action grade. Applies to PLAN/FINDING/KNOWN_ISSUE; see .claude/instructions/value-rubric.md. Omit for types it doesn't apply to.

themes.description: Ordered, primary-first subject-area tags from the controlled vocabulary. Applies to PLAN/FINDING/KNOWN_ISSUE; see .claude/instructions/theme-vocabulary.md. Omit for types it doesn't apply to.

tags.description: Free-form keyword tags, finer-grained than themes and not from a controlled vocabulary. Omit if there are none.
